From supermarkets to restaurants, residents of Business Bay can find it all in the area. [...] Location continues to steal the spotlight as the single most influential factor affecting price per square foot in Dubai. Prime areas like Palm Jumeirah command premium rates exceeding AED 3,500 per sq. ft., while emerging neighbourhoods like Arjan offer more accessible entry points with prices of AED 1,355 per sq. ft. The proximity to key attractions, business districts and waterfront views creates significant price variations even within the same community. ### How do off-plan property prices per square foot compare to ready properties in Dubai? Off-plan sales continue to dominate property transactions across both apartments and villas. This trend reflects investor confidence in Dubai’s future growth trajectory and developers’ track records.
